enriched_activities.desc: Lie face down on the bed with head on pillow. Pull the duvet up to the shoulders. Turn onto the left side. Bend knees and pull legs up. Stretch the right arm out. Turn onto the back. Breathe slowly with eyes closed. Turn onto the right side. Pull the pillow toward the chest. Adjust the pillow under the head with the left hand. Roll onto the stomach. Push the duvet down to the waist. Pull the duvet back up. Turn the head to the other side. Rest the hands under the pillow. Remain motionless. Turn onto the left side again.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, washing face, brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Put both feet on the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step in. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Step under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub shampoo into the hair with both hands. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub soap over the arms, chest and legs. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out. Pick up the towel from the rail. Rub the hair with the towel. Wipe the face and body. Hang the towel back on the rail. Turn on the basin tap. Cup water in both hands and splash the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth up and down. Rinse the mouth with water. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing university bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take a shirt off the hanger. Pull on the shirt and button it. Take trousers from the shelf. Step into the trousers and pull them up. Fasten the button and zip. Put on socks. Open the drawer and take out a pair of sneakers. Sit on the bed. Put on the sneakers and tie the laces. Stand up. Pick up the backpack from the chair. Open the main zipper. Place the laptop into the padded sleeve. Insert the charger and the notebook. Zip the front pocket closed. Put the pencil case into the side pocket. Zip the backpack shut. Lift the backpack and set it beside the door. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Check the time on the screen.

Walk into the kitchen carrying the phone. Say 'Good morning' to Member 3. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Set it on the counter. Close the refrigerator. Pick up a bowl from the cupboard. Place the bowl on the counter. Open the cereal box. Pour cereal into the bowl. Pour milk over the cereal. Put the milk carton back into the refrigerator. Open the cutlery drawer. Pick up a spoon. Close the drawer. Sit down at the table opposite Member 3. Lift the spoon and eat the cereal. Take a bite of toast from the plate. Pick up the glass of water and drink. Talk with Member 3 about the day's classes. Stand up. Carry the bowl and spoon to the sink. Rinse the bowl. Place it in the dish rack. Wipe the table with a cloth. Pick up the phone from the table. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing business notes and preparing for classes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down at the desk. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the backpack. Take out the business notebook. Place it on the desk. Flip through the pages to the last lecture notes. Run the index finger down the page. Pick up a pen. Underline three key terms. Turn the page. Read the case study notes. Pick up the phone. Open the course app. Scroll through the timetable. Turn off the phone screen. Set the phone on the desk. Close the notebook. Put the notebook back into the backpack. Zip the pocket. Turn off the desk lamp. Stand up. Pick up the backpack. Walk to the door. Open the door and step out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the front door. Pull the door shut. Carry the backpack on the shoulders. Walk along the footpath to the bus stop. Stop at the crossing. Press the pedestrian button. Wait for the signal. Cross the road. Arrive at the bus stop. Stand under the shelter. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the screen. Put the phone back. Step onto the bus when it arrives. Tap the Myki card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Hold the handrail. Sit in an empty seat. Set the backpack on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up at the Clayton stop. Tap the Myki card on the reader again. Step off the bus. Walk along the campus path. Push open the glass door of the business building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending business classes at Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the lecture theatre. Walk down the steps. Sit in a middle-row seat. Set the backpack on the floor. Take out the notebook and a pen. Place them on the fold-out desk. Open the laptop. Type the login password. Open the lecture slides file. Look at the projector screen. Write the lecture title in the notebook. Type notes on the keyboard. Raise the hand to ask a question. Say 'Could you repeat the last point?'. Write the answer down. Close the laptop at the break. Stand up. Walk to the corridor. Buy a bottle of water from the vending machine. Press the button. Pick up the bottle. Walk back. Sit down. Reopen the laptop for the tutorial. Work in a group of four. Read the case prompt aloud. Write the group answers on the shared document. Close the laptop. Put the notebook into the backpack. Stand up. Walk out of the lecture theatre.

enriched_activities.activity: Having lunch at Monash University Clayton campus with Member 3 and Member 4
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the campus food court. Meet Member 3 and Member 4 at the entrance. Say 'Hi, did you get lunch yet?'. Walk to the food counter. Point at the rice dish. Pick up a tray. Pay the cashier by card. Tap the card on the reader. Carry the tray to a table. Sit down between Member 3 and Member 4. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice and vegetables. Talk with Member 3 about the morning lecture. Laugh at Member 4's story about the lab. Drink water from the bottle. Pick up the phone. Scroll through messages. Put the phone down. Stand up. Carry the tray to the return station. Place the tray on the rack. Walk back to the table. Pick up the backpack. Say goodbye to Member 3 and Member 4. Walk toward the bus stop.

Walk to the bus stop outside the campus. Stand under the shelter. Take the phone out. Check the route on the transport app. Put the phone back in the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the Myki card on the reader. Walk along the aisle. Hold the overhead handrail. Stand near the rear door. Get off at the Chadstone interchange. Tap the Myki card. Walk along the covered walkway. Push open the glass door of the shopping centre. Walk through the concourse. Pass the food court. Turn left at the escalator. Ride the escalator up. Walk to the staff entrance. Push the staff door open. Walk into the back room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working part-time retail shift at Chadstone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the staff room. Open the locker. Put the backpack inside. Take out the uniform shirt. Pull on the uniform shirt. Clip the name badge onto the chest. Close the locker. Walk onto the shop floor. Clock in at the terminal. Press the fingerprint scanner. Greet the store manager. Stand at the entrance. Say 'Hi, welcome in' to customers. Fold T-shirts on the display table. Stack them in size order. Straighten the hangers on the rack. Pick up a fallen price tag. Re-attach the tag to the hanger. Walk to the fitting rooms. Count the items and hand out the numbered tags. Pick up the discarded clothes from the cubicle. Carry them to the rack. Re-hang the garments. Walk to the register. Scan an item with the barcode scanner. Take the card payment. Hand the receipt to the customer. Say 'Thanks, have a good day'. Fold the next pile of stock. Restock the shelf from the carton. Cut the tape with the box cutter. Refill the paper bags at the register. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Clock out at the terminal.

Walk to the staff room. Open the locker. Take out the backpack. Unclip the name badge. Take off the uniform shirt. Put on the casual shirt. Place the uniform shirt into the backpack. Close the locker. Walk out of the staff door. Ride the escalator down. Walk through the shopping centre concourse. Push open the glass door. Walk to the bus stop. Stand under the shelter. Take out the phone. Check the bus time. Step onto the bus. Tap the Myki card on the reader. Sit in an empty seat. Set the backpack on the lap. Get off at the local stop. Tap the Myki card. Walk along the footpath to the house. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the door.

Walk into the kitchen carrying the backpack. Set the backpack on a chair. Say 'Hi' to Member 3. Walk to the stove. Pick up a plate from the cupboard. Spoon rice onto the plate. Spoon the curry onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down next to Member 3. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice and curry. Talk with Member 3 about the retail shift. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Cut a piece of the vegetable with the fork. Pick up a second helping from the pot. Stand up. Carry the empty plate to the sink. Rinse the plate. Place it in the dish rack. Wipe the table with a cloth. Pick up the backpack. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with Member 5
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Set the backpack on the sofa armrest. Sit down on the sofa next to Member 5. Say 'What are you watching?'. Pick up the TV remote from the coffee table. Press the power button. Aim the remote at the TV. Press the volume up button. Press the channel button. Lean back against the cushion. Cross the legs. Take the phone out of the pocket. Scroll through the news feed. Put the phone on the armrest. Pick up the remote again. Switch to the sports channel. Say to Member 5 'Let's watch this one'. Point at the screen. Lean forward. Pick up the glass of water from the table. Drink. Set the glass back down.

Sit on the sofa with the legs stretched out. Hold the TV remote in the right hand. Press the volume down button. Place the remote on the coffee table. Watch the screen. Pick up the phone from the armrest. Open the messaging app. Type a reply to a classmate. Send the message. Put the phone face down on the sofa. Lean back. Pull the cushion behind the back. Cross the arms. Pick up the glass of water. Drink the last mouthful. Set the glass on the table. Press the power button on the remote to check the time display. Lean forward. Stand up from the sofa. Pick up the backpack. Walk toward the hallway.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying and completing assignments on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Set the backpack on the chair. Sit down at the desk. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the backpack. Take out the laptop. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password. Open the assignment document. Open the lecture slides in a second window. Copy the reference into the bibliography. Type two paragraphs of the report. Open the university library page. Search for a journal article. Download the PDF. Read the abstract on the screen. Highlight a sentence with the cursor. Type a citation into the document. Pick up the phone. Set a ten-minute timer. Put the phone down. Continue typing. Stand up. Stretch both arms above the head. Sit down again. Open the spreadsheet file. Enter the sales figures into the cells. Save the file with Ctrl+S. Close the browser tabs. Open the group chat. Send the draft to the group. Read the replies. Check the clock on the screen. Save the document again. Turn off the desk lamp. Close the laptop lid.

enriched_activities.activity: Organizing study materials and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the notebooks from the desk. Stack them in size order. Place the stack on the shelf. Collect the loose papers. Clip them together. Put them into the folder. Close the folder. Slide the folder into the backpack. Zip the backpack. Place the backpack beside the desk. Pick up the pen. Put the pen into the pencil case. Close the pencil case. Plug the laptop charger into the wall socket. Connect the cable to the laptop. Pick up the phone. Plug the charging cable in. Set the phone on the bedside table. Pull the curtain closed. Adjust the fan speed knob. Turn off the main light. Sit on the bed.

Walk to the bathroom. Push the door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the basin tap. Cup water in both hands and splash the face. Pick up the soap. Rub soap over the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face dry. Hang the towel back on the rail. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Put the toothbrush into the holder. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out.

Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn off the fan. Lie down on the bed. Pull the duvet over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Turn onto the left side. Bend the arms under the pillow. Turn onto the back. Pull the duvet up to the chin. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Stretch the legs out. Roll onto the stomach. Place the hands under the cheek. Remain still with eyes closed. Turn onto the left side again. Pull the duvet down to the shoulder.
